title: 第二十三章 三大加莱精神方程式第二十四章 这小子真会捞钱
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
娜莎盯着光球中的少年，目光里带着一丝复杂。
昨天她用探测巫术检测到莫宁精神强度的变化——那0.01点的跃升，给了她一个小小的惊讶。
所以她自然明白，这小子新的研究方向是什么。
尖耳女学徒喃喃自语，声音轻得只有自己能听见：
“精神领域的研究，可比研究次零级戏法的难度高太多了，没有你想得这么简单。”
虽然觉得莫宁有点好高骛远，可她对他这种行为非常赞赏。
这是聪明人的做法。
娜莎见过太多新人，甚至是一级学徒，抱着家传的秘法敝帚自珍。
那些人将其当成压箱底的底牌，当成超越他人的依仗，唯恐被人觊觎。
这种心态太可笑了。
学院拥有多少好东西？
那些沉睡了千年的典籍，那些堆满了整个楼层的秘卷，甚至一些连名字都叫不出来的古老手稿——怎么可能看得上你们家传的又浅薄又低劣的秘术？
别说是学徒级别的秘术，就算是巫师级别的秘术，学院的图书馆里都一抓一大把。
等到那些人获得了更高的权限，第一次亲眼看到图书馆内的书目，表情往往非常精彩。
真正聪明的人，进入学院后，会直接将其捐献出来。
而学院出于鼓励分享知识的态度，通常多多少少会奖励一些黑塔点。
她见过那样的人。
不多，但大多数都达到了比同龄人更高的高度。
光球中。
墨管笔停了几秒，又开始快速移动：

“根据我相当有限的认知，在新人和一级学徒阶段，也就是精神萌芽开始萌发的初期……”
“与提升精神强度有关的秘法术数程式，主要是三大加莱精神方程式。
“即——‘加莱精神流变方程’、‘加莱精神频震方程’、‘加莱精神稳态敛合方程’。”
娜莎将文字尽收眼底。
然后，她感觉认知又遭受了一次小小的冲击。
她低语道：“很多三级学徒都没有涉猎过三大加莱精神方程式……这小子居然连这个都懂。”
三大加莱精神方程式——这是精神领域基础研究中，无法绕开的重要里程碑。
秘法术数时代的先驱者，加莱阁下，用简洁明了的术数语言，第一次揭示了精神增长的奥秘。
自此之后，精神领域的研究，才真正进入了术数时代。
这三个复杂的术数方程，娜莎当然学过。
但那是晋升三级学徒之后的事。
而眼前这个新人，连灵环都没有凝聚，却在纸上写下了三个名字。
女学徒开始觉得，这小子突然开启精神领域的新课题，可能并不是好高骛远。
而是真的摸到了一点门道。
毕竟——
“这小子是导师都认可的术数天才。”
娜莎自然而然找到了一个合理的理由。
content_en:
Nasha stared at the young man in the ball of light, with a hint of complexity in her eyes.
Yesterday, she used detection witchcraft to detect changes in Mourning's mental strength - the 0.01 point jump, which gave her a small surprise.
So she naturally understood what this boy's new research direction was.
The pointed-eared female apprentice murmured to herself, her voice so soft that only she could hear:
"Research in the spiritual field is much more difficult than studying sub-zero magic. It's not as simple as you think."
Although she felt that Moning was a bit too ambitious, she admired his behavior very much.
This is what smart people do.
Nasha has seen too many newcomers, even first-level apprentices, cherishing the secret broom passed down from their family.
Those people regard it as a trump card to keep the bottom of the box, as a way to surpass others, for fear of being coveted by others.
This mentality is so ridiculous.
How many good things does the college have?
Those ancient books that have been dormant for thousands of years, those secret scrolls piled up on the entire floor, and even some ancient manuscripts that cannot even be named - how can they regard the shallow and inferior secret arts passed down by your family?
Not to mention apprentice-level secrets, even wizard-level secrets are available in the academy's library.
When those people gain higher authority and see the books in the library for the first time, their expressions are often very exciting.
Really smart people will donate it directly after entering the academy.
In order to encourage the sharing of knowledge, the academy usually rewards some black tower points.
She had seen people like that.
Not many, but most have reached greater heights than their peers.
In the ball of light.
The ink pen stopped for a few seconds and then started moving quickly:
"According to my rather limited knowledge, during the newcomer and first-level apprenticeship stages, that is, the early stages of spiritual growth..."
"The secret magic formulas related to improving spiritual strength are mainly the three Calais spiritual formulas.
"That is - the 'Calais Mental Rheology Equation', the 'Calais Mental Frequency Shock Equation', and the 'Calais Mental Steady State Convergence Equation'. "
Nasha took in all the words.
Then, she felt another small shock to her cognition.
She whispered: "Many third-level apprentices have never dabbled in the three Calais spiritual equations... This kid actually even understands this. "
The Three Calais Spiritual Equations - This is an important milestone that cannot be avoided in basic research in the spiritual field.
The pioneer of the age of occult magic, Lord Calais, used concise and clear magic language to reveal the secret of spiritual growth for the first time.
Since then, research in the spiritual field has truly entered the age of magic.
Of course Nasha had learned these three complex mathematical equations.
But that was after being promoted to third-level apprentice.
But the newcomer in front of him didn't even have his spiritual ring condensed, but he wrote three names on the paper.
The female apprentice began to feel that this boy might not be so ambitious when he suddenly started a new subject in the spiritual field.
But I really got a feel for it.
After all——
“This kid is a genius in arithmetic recognized by his mentors. "
Nasha naturally found a reasonable reason.
